discussion.body:
Update pass. Barrel is vertical / spaceward. Who it is built to hit stays open; Vortan still names Fire as the public target.
Base under the machine is older unlit ruins: smooth pale blocks, Fallen color and form, no window glow. Constium iron is a collar bolted on later. Fissure remains under the cliff. Old sideways-cannon plate is superseded for aim.
Local: artifacts/Concept art/FEAT-004-worldcannon-vertical.jpg. Index: https://github.com/Stackocakes-Hub/Grok-Host
